rewrites.//: Shared recipe links are `/r/<recipe id>`, and the ids are Firebase push keys for recipes generated long after this site is built — so there is no set of pages to pre-render. One static page (src/app/r/page.tsx) answers all of them and reads the id from the URL on the client. NOTE ON `ignore` ABOVE: `**/.*` was removed from it and must not come back — it matches `.well-known`, which would build the two app-association files into `out/` and then silently leave them out of every deploy.

headers.//: iOS demands `application/json` on the association file, which has no extension for Firebase to guess from — served as anything else it is ignored and universal links silently fall back to the browser. The short cache is Apple’s own guidance: their CDN re-fetches it, so a corrected file reaches phones in minutes rather than days.

Pages are directory URLs under `trailingSlash: true` (`/`, `/about/`), so they never match the extension rule above — Firebase matches the request URL, not the file it resolves to. Without this they fall back to Firebase's default `max-age=3600` and edits take an hour to appear.
